tips.title: MONEY MATTERS
tips.body: Some story missions only continue once you've made enough money. Earning cash in free roam is part of the game.

tips.title: ROB STORES + BANKS
tips.body: Hold up stores, businesses and banks, solo or as a couple. Jobs together help the relationship.

tips.title: SELL STOLEN CARS
tips.body: Boosting and selling cars is one of the main ways to earn. Car fences buy stolen rides.

tips.title: FIND A FENCE
tips.body: Stolen goods don't pay out on their own: sell them to a fence. There are fences for jewelry and cars.

tips.title: BANK YOUR CASH
tips.body: Cash you carry can be lost if you die. Deposit it at an ATM: money in the bank is safe.
